label: sec:atomic-shells-foundations-skein-finiteness-bound-preamble
html: The sequence proceeds from the torus-knot shell-binding tables to the skein-finiteness bound. This establishes the substrate-level finiteness condition for atomic shells. We relate the finiteness bound to the substrate parameter q and identify the controlling categorical mechanism. The output provides the skein-finiteness bound and the per-shell binding-energy tables required for element-instance predictions.
